item.title: Bulletin updated at 12:55 HKT 25/Sep/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An anticyclone aloft will cover southern China in the next couple of days. The northeast monsoon is expected to reach the coast of southern China in the latter part of this week. There will be a few showers over the region. Meanwhile, the broad area of low pressure over the central part of the South China Sea will develop gradually, and may move towards the vicinity of Hainan Island and Beibu Wan early next week. Under the combined effect of the area of low pressure and the northeast monsoon, it will be windier with showers over the coast of Guangdong and the northern part of the South China Sea. Besides, the tropical depression over the seas east of Vietnam will move towards the central part of Vietnam today and tomorrow.
